verdict.rationale: Loops provides documented event-triggered workflow automation: sending an event via the API triggers published workflows (loops-docs-3), and workflows themselves can be created/edited programmatically with branching logic (loops-docs-27), enabling onboarding/activation/winback automations (loops-docs-15, loops-docs-30). This matches the AI-native automation story of defining rules that fire on events. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that workflow branching and event-triggering work reliably in practice, and more detail on conditional logic capabilities beyond docs claims.
